title: King Charles, Mountbatten and Savile's black berets

tellings.quote:
him and Lord Mountbatton

and uh Jimmy Savile used to all hang out
together

and they all had special black berets
made.

plain: In the 1970s and 80s, the story goes, King Charles, Lord Mountbatten and the British TV star Jimmy Savile "used to all hang out together" and had special black berets made for themselves. Kurt Metzger tells it on an episode about Jeffrey Epstein, as something he was told, to suggest a private circle linking the royal family to Savile.
